comparisons.reason: The constructs differ. Item 0 is 1 if any comment argues against or engages the OP's main premise or central claim at the general level, as opposed to a specific example. That includes a direct challenge to the central claim or conclusion. Item 1 is 1 only if a comment explicitly challenges an underlying or foundational assumption or presupposition, and it excludes comments that only dispute facts or the conclusion. A comment attacking the OP's central claim would score 1 on item 0 but 0 on item 1. Their null rules also differ: item 0 gives null if title or argument is missing, while item 1 gives null only if both are missing.
